channel.title: The Drill Down: New England Patriots
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Patriots at Chargers
item.description: Sun 11/29 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: LAC -1.5 · O/U 35.5 | Model LAC 27% vs. market 44% | The Chargers must lean on deep throws to the right, 18% of their passes and 2nd-most in the league, while New England's defense allows +0.45 EPA per throw there, the worst mark. Drake Maye, ranked 10th of 31 quarterbacks, faces Justin Herbert, who ranks last among them, so the passing matchup tilts toward New England. Our model puts New England at 73% against a market price of 56%, with the starting quarterback and the passing matchup doing most of the lifting.

item.title: Week 10: Patriots at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 9:30 AM ET | Line: DET -2.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model DET 54% vs. market 57% | The trenches decide this game: Detroit's pass rush generates pressure on 23% of dropbacks, and New England's line allows that same rate, so Maye's protection will shape everything. Amon-Ra St. Brown draws 33% of Detroit's targets and runs routes against a New England pass defense ranked 21st. Our model puts Detroit at 54% against the market's 57%, with the rushing matchup providing most of the lift toward the Lions.
